Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) SCOPE OF WORK – AMC FOR MULTIFUCNTION PRINTERS AT ICMR-NIPCR, HYDERA BAD The Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) shall cover the printers installed at ICMR-NIPCR, Genom e Valley, Turkapally, Hyderabad-500101, as per the details provided in Table. S.No Printer Qty 1 Cannon imageRUNNER C3120 (Colour) 1 2 Xerox Versalink (Model B7035) 2 3 Xerox Versalink (Model B7125) 5 4 Konica Minolta bizhub 266i 1 1. Preventive Maintenance: The Contractor shall carry out preventive maintenance of all printers at least once every quarter (minimum four visits per year) and as per the Institute's requirement, including ins pection, cleaning, servicing, testing, alignment, wherever applicable, and necessary troubleshooting. But initial maintenance of all Multifunction Printer will be completed within 30 days from date of issuin g contract order. 2. Breakdown Maintenance: The Contractor shall attend to all complaints/breakdowns reported by ICMR- NIPCR, diagnose and rectify the faults, and restore the printers to working condition, with all service vi sits and labour charges covered under the AMC. 3. Response and Resolution Time: The Contractor shall attend to each reported complaint promptly and make all reasonable efforts to rectify the printer within 48 working hours from the time of reporting th

rough email, and where on-site repair is not possible, the printer may be taken to the Contractor's se rvice centre with prior permission of the Institute at their own expenses. 4. Spares/Parts: Since the AMC is non-comprehensive, the cost of replacement of defective parts/spares s hall not be included in the AMC charges and shall be procured/replaced only with prior approval of the Competent Authority, while the applicable labour/service charges shall be covered under the AMC. Th e bidder shall be solely responsible for all necessary software upgrades and updates required to ensu re that the printer remains in proper working condition. To ensure transparency, the bidder shall subm it a model-wise price list of all major spare parts along with the bid document, with prices in line with prevailing market discounted rates. 5. Consumables and Utilities: Toner/cartridges/ink and other printing consumables, printing paper, and el ectricity/power supply required for operation of the printers shall be the responsibility of ICMR-NIPCR a nd shall not form part of the AMC, while the Contractor shall provide necessary support during installa tion/replacement/configuration of such consumables, wherever required. 6. Service Reports: The Contractor shall submit a service report after every preventive maintenance/brea kdown visit indicating the complaint, date of visit, fault identified, action taken, parts replaced, if any, and status of the printer, duly acknowledged by the authorised representative of ICMR-NIPCR. 7. Service Personnel: The Contractor shall provide qualified and experienced service personnel equipped with the necessary tools and equipment for servicing, maintenance, troubleshooting and repair of the printers during the contract period 8. AMC Period: The AMC shall be valid for a period of one year from the date of the Contract/Service Orde r and may be extended further based on satisfactory performance and approval of the Competent Aut hority. 9. Payment: No advance payment will be made and Payment shall be made as per the terms and conditi ons of the GeM Contract Order, subject to satisfactory performance of the AMC and submission of serv ice reports/certification by the authorised representative of ICMR-NIPCR. 10. General Conditions: The Contractor shall comply with all security, safety and administrative instructio ns of ICMR-NIPCR while providing services at the Institute. 11. The interested service provider shall inspect the site on any working days between Monday to Friday( mandatorily 10:00 Hrs to 17.00Hrs) and submit the site inspection report along with the bid documents while uploading the documents on the GeM Portal. 12. Service & Support: An office of the Service provider must be located in the state of Consignee. Docu mentary evidence to be submitted. 13. The Service Provider shall have the experience for servicing and maintenance of multifunction printer s and submit copies of AMC contracts/work orders at least last three years as proof of relevant experie nce. 14. The Service Provider shall submit a duly filled-in compliance sheet/scope of work against all the abov e Buyer Added Specific Additional Terms and Conditions (ATC) in their company letterhead. 10.
